findings.problem: KB-053 says 'Open API cho phép 60 request mỗi phút cho mỗi account' with no condition. Spec-hub itself (api-tokens-request-rates, in the evidence file and re-verified in log 204) says an account with a store on the Transactional plan gets 300/min. That caveat appears only in OQ-open-api-057, OQ-open-api-049 and the profile unknown_area, not in the KB statement a tester reads.
findings.evidence: raw/ccr-evidence/CBS-132__CLAIM-01/spec-hub-open-api-rate-and-asset-limits.json related_rules_same_query.api-tokens-request-rates; spec-hub log_id 204. KB-053 is PROPOSED/LOW and is not an oracle (CHK-068 has no expected), so there is no checklist impact.
findings.required_fix: Optional, non-blocking: add one hedge sentence to KB-053, e.g. 'spec-hub có rule khác (api-tokens-request-rates, không nạp) nêu 300/phút cho account có store Transactional; 60 có thể chỉ là mặc định (OQ-open-api-057).' This does not load the other rule as knowledge.

findings.problem: KB-053 bundles two independent rules from two spec-hub features: the per-minute request rate (open-api-rate, feature open-api) and the daily asset-creation limit (api-tokens-asset-limits, feature api-tokens). If a later S3 source confirms only one of them, it can only partly supersede this item.
findings.evidence: qa_rule_ref.code = 'spec-hub:api-tokens-asset-limits, spec-hub:open-api-rate'; the CCR's CLAIM-01 already bundles the two.
findings.required_fix: No change required for this run. In future CCRs, prefer one KB item per rule code.
